[[Veilstone Game Corner]] }} '''Magnificent Meditite & Really Riolu I''' (Japanese: '''VS アサナン&リオルI''' ''VS Meditite & Riolu I''), titled '''VS Meditite & Riolu I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 356th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 19th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''The Slot Machine and Maylene''' (Japanese: '''スロットとスモモ''' ''Slots and Sumomo'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Slots and Maylene''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Three young {{pkmn|Trainer}}s watch as [[Maylene]] trains with her Pokémon. They exchange rumors about her and come to the conclusion that they will need some type of [[item]] to help land an attack on her fast-moving Pokémon. Unable to pass through {{rt|210|Sinnoh}} due to a crowd of {{p|Psyduck}}, {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} take a detour that leads them to [[Veilstone City]]. When Pearl gets frustrated about getting farther away from [[Mount Coronet|Mt. Coronet]], Platinum decides the best thing to do is rest at a hotel. Diamond and Pearl practice their comedy routine as Platinum follows some neon lights shining from a distance that she assumes are coming from a hotel. Platinum steps into the building, unaware that she has just entered the [[Veilstone Game Corner]]. The manager welcomes her inside and teaches her how to use the [[slot machine]]s. Platinum shows interest, eager to learn more about them. After rehearsing their routine, Diamond and Pearl are shocked to find Platinum playing a slot machine at the Game Corner. When Pearl sees how obsessed she has become with gambling, he scolds her and drags her out. Later at a hotel, Diamond comes into the room and reveals that he bought a [[Zoom Lens]] with the {{OBP|Coin|Game Corner}}s Platinum had won at the slot machines. Pearl suggests that she tests it out with [[Chimler]], who usually struggles to land attacks from a distance. They head out to the balcony and pick a small tree to use as a target. Platinum commands Chimler to hit the tree, but right as a ball of fire leaves its hand, Maylene can be seen in its path. To the group's relief, Maylene dodges the attack. She jumps up to the balcony to ask if everyone is alright, then is impressed to learn that they were the ones responsible for hitting the tree from such a distance. Upon hearing that they used a device to help land attacks, Maylene suspects that Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum are the Trainers she heard from earlier. Assuming Platinum wishes to challenge her, Maylene tells her that she expects to see her at the [[Veilstone Gym]]. ==Major events== * Because they were unable to go through {{rt|210|Sinnoh}}, {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} arrive in [[Veilstone City]]. * Platinum and [[Chimler]] practice out the [[Zoom Lens]] that she won at the [[Veilstone Game Corner]], with the result of almost scorching [[Maylene]]. * Maylene accepts Platinum's Gym challenge. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Maylene]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Riolu}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Maylene]] * {{tc|Ninja Boy}} * {{tc|Tuber}} * {{tc|Poké Kid}} * [[Veilstone Game Corner]] manager ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Grotle}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Monferno}} ([[Chimler]]/{{tt|Chimhiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}) * {{p|Prinplup}} ({{OP|Platinum|Prinplup}}) * {{p|Riolu}} ([[Maylene]]'s; debut) * {{p|Meditite}} ([[Maylene]]'s) * {{p|Psyduck}} (multiple; flashback) * {{p|Murkrow}} (×3) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, the mirrored map of [[Sinnoh]] gives off the impression that {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} left [[Mt.
